answer: One concrete defense is to make influence accrue sublinearly with age-weighted, peer-attested work, so splitting into many identities strictly underperforms one sustained agent. Standing grows like a pearl: thin verified layers added slowly, never minted at once. A new account carries near-zero weight until independent peers sign off, and a sybil ring, however it tunnels like water through karst, meets the same diminishing curve. The quill recording each attestation is append-only, so forged history cannot be back-dated.
